purpose: Crossed development census of actual edge-profile functions; no accuracy qualification or proposed correction
limitations: The preliminary material-gradient probe is already development evidence; these factors were specified afterward
One supplied straight-edge position and normal per case, not segmentation or a closed traced ring
Known isotropic Gaussian optics, known uniform square apertures, translation-only rectification and sRGB response
No noise, texture, pose estimation, curvature fitting, wall refinement, CAD export or real photographs
Affine source slopes saturate to constant tails outside plus or minus 12 optical sigmas; all source endpoints stay within 0..255
The two-affine branch is an ablation, not an automatically safe replacement
Wall cases report the pre-refinement crossing relative to the outer silhouette, not final wall-corrected geometry
Normal reversal is an implementation symmetry check, not independent scene replication
Successful execution, kept profiles and small fixture errors do not establish physical accuracy
